en.ammaar-muslim: [12/1561] Thawab al-A’mal: From his father from Muhammad b. Yahya al-Attar from al-Amraki b. Ali from Ali b. Ja’far from his brother Musa b. Ja’far عليهما السلام who said:

Ali عليه السلام said: Whoever prays Ṣalāt al-Fajr (the dawn prayer) and then recites Qul Huwa l-Llāhu Aḥad eleven times - no sin will follow this on that day, though the Devil’s nose be soiled (i.e. though the Devil be humiliated because he will try to persuade one to sin but will not succeed however much he tries)
